q: The green colouring in leaves is ____.
explain: Chlorophyll traps sunlight.

q: A magnet attracts objects made of ____.
explain: Magnets attract iron.

q: Evaporation is liquid changing to ____.
explain: Liquid → gas is evaporation.

q: Blood is carried away from the heart in ____.
explain: Arteries leave the heart; veins return.

q: Plants need water, air and ____ to make food.
explain: Photosynthesis needs sunlight.

q: The three states of matter are solid, liquid and ____.
explain: Matter: solid, liquid, gas.

q: Animals with a backbone are called ____.
explain: Fish, birds, mammals and amphibians are vertebrates.

q: The green plant gas given out in sunlight is mainly ____.
explain: Photosynthesis releases oxygen.

q: Animals that eat only plants are ____.
explain: Herbivores eat plants.

q: Cutting down too many trees is ____.
explain: Deforestation destroys forests.

q: Renewable energy examples include solar and ____.
explain: Sun and wind can be replenished.

q: Clay soil feels ____ when wet.
explain: Clay holds water and is sticky.

q: Adults have ____ permanent teeth.
explain: A full adult set is 32 teeth.

q: Red blood cells carry ____.
explain: Haemoglobin in red cells carries oxygen.

q: Animals that eat only flesh are ____.
explain: Carnivores eat flesh.

q: We cannot hear sound in a ____.
explain: Sound needs a medium; space is almost a vacuum.

q: A lever and a pulley are ____.
explain: Simple machines make work easier.

q: We inhale ____.
explain: Living things need oxygen.

q: A transparent material ____ light to pass.
explain: Clear glass is transparent.

q: Decomposers such as fungi help to ____.
explain: They return nutrients to the soil.

q: Boiling water turns to steam at ____ °C.
explain: Water boils at 100°C.

q: Animals without a backbone are ____.
explain: Insects, worms and snails are invertebrates.

q: Plastic is a good ____.
explain: Plastic does not conduct electricity well.

q: A shadow forms when light is ____.
explain: Opaque objects block light.

q: Condensation is gas changing to ____.
explain: Gas → liquid is condensation.

q: Carbon dioxide is used by plants in ____.
explain: Plants take in CO₂ and give out oxygen in light.

q: Water freezes at ____ °C.
explain: Water freezes at 0°C.

q: Energy from the sun is called ____ energy.
explain: Solar energy comes from the sun.

q: The Earth moving around the sun is ____.
explain: Revolution takes about 365 days.

q: The moon gets its light from the ____.
explain: The moon reflects sunlight.

q: A thermometer measures ____.
explain: Temperature is how hot or cold something is.

q: Non-renewable fuels include coal and ____.
explain: Fossil fuels take millions of years to form.

q: Mammals feed their young with ____.
explain: Humans, goats and cats are mammals.

q: White blood cells help the body to ____.
explain: They are part of the immune system.

q: The seed of a plant grows after ____.
explain: Germination is when a seed starts to grow.

q: A habitat is a place where an organism ____.
explain: Pond, forest and desert are habitats.

q: The unit of temperature we use in class is ____.
explain: Water freezes at 0°C and boils at 100°C.

q: Materials that allow electricity to pass are ____.
explain: Metals like copper conduct electricity.

q: Spiders have ____ legs.
explain: Spiders are arachnids with 8 legs.

q: The brain is part of the ____ system.
explain: The brain and nerves control the body.

q: Sound travels fastest through a ____.
explain: Particles are closest in solids, so sound travels faster.

q: Proteins help the body to ____.
explain: Beans, fish and eggs are body-building foods.

q: Loamy soil is good for farming because it ____.

q: The system that breaks down food is the ____ system.
explain: Digestion starts in the mouth.

q: Air pollution can be caused by ____.

q: We breathe with our ____.

q: An inclined plane is a ____.
explain: A ramp is an inclined plane.

q: A push or a pull is a ____.
